subject: planner: move logical limit/topn/sort into logicalop pkg. (#55115)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent focusing on planner semantics. The change is a refactor moving `LogicalLimit`/`LogicalTopN`/`LogicalSort` into `pkg/planner/core/operator/logicalop`, with behavior preserved by relocating helpers (EXPLAIN formatting, limit stats derivation) to `pkg/planner/util` and wiring `ExhaustPhysicalPlans`/`PruneByItems` through `pkg/planner/util/utilfuncp` function pointers initialized in `pkg/planner/core/core_init.go`. Checked the moved operator logic and the new `exhaustPhysicalPlans4Logical{Sort,TopN,Limit}` wrappers in `pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go` against the prior in-method implementations; no correctness/SQL-semantics/data-consistency/privilege/session/concurrency regressions found.
